subject: prd/abandoned-feature-retirement
statement: Require typed terminal dispositions for product obligations, governing designs, and affected frozen-plan traces before retirement authority.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: An abandoned implementation cannot be removed while its authoritative contracts still require it. FR-2 and UB-1 make lifecycle coherence a preflight rather than cleanup fallout.
fit_criterion: Live requirement, live design, missing supersession, and unresolved plan-trace fixtures publish zero authority; terminal controls pass.
